title: The first Global Heat Forum, in Bangkok
summary: Nearly 600 scientists, business leaders, philanthropists and health experts met in Bangkok from 6 to 9 October 2026. The Forum released the first country-level heat and health assessments for Bangladesh, Bhutan, India and Nepal, and a roadmap for investment and action on extreme heat.

title: Bangladesh’s first urban heatwave action plan, for Narayanganj
summary: Bangladesh’s first heat and health assessment, released in October 2026, reports that the country’s first urban heatwave action plan has been developed for Narayanganj, alongside national guidelines for heat-related illness and a public campaign, “Beat the Heat”.
